title: BlackboardItem
description: One card on the shared live blackboard: structured, timestamped, source-linked harbor state — active goals, blockers, file heat, unresolved parleys, decisions waiting for the operator, similar-work and do-not-duplicate warnings (binder ch04 'Transcript search and blackboard'; ch05 'Blackboard'). READ-ONLY CONTRACT (ADR-0097, normative — scope guard): this v0 schema is the READ MODEL ONLY. Binder ch05 explicitly defers the write side: 'Milestone 6 should ship a read-only/search blackboard over transcript and memory facts; active conflict/parley write semantics belong in Milestone 8.' Therefore this schema carries NO write/parley/acknowledgement/mutation/permission-grant fields — no writeToken, no parleyState, no ackRequired, no proposal/vote fields, no writer-permission grants. Do not add them here; M8 will introduce a separate contract (or a v0-additive delta under its own ADR) for write semantics. The item is a projection over ledger facts plus explicit Longshoreman assertions (ch05): assertedBy is provenance of the underlying fact, not a write API. CITATION RULE: source-linked, not a loose chat (ch04) — citations has minItems 1. Citation cross-field enforcement is runtime, per the compaction-packet pattern.

kind.description: Open string for tolerant reading (transcript-event kind discipline). Known kinds (ch04/ch05): active-goal, blocker, file-heat, contested-file, unresolved-parley, pending-operator-decision, recent-decision, similar-work-warning, do-not-duplicate, test-failure, open-contradiction, pr-queue, suggested-next-move, transcript-episode.

detail.description: Card detail text the operator sees. Cards, badges, search, and timeline — not raw JSON (ch05). Named `detail`, not `body`: `body` is a superseded ch03 name for the runtime Body (ADR-0095 fork 1) and must not reappear on any contract.

subjects.description: What the item is about, as typed refs (files, agents, sessions, claims, PRs, tests, routes).

kind.description: Open string. Known: file, agent-node, session, run, claim, pr, issue, test, route, doc.

agentNodeId.description: Primary agent join key, when the item is about one agent.

status.description: Read-model status of the underlying fact. Status transitions happen in the ledger/projection, never by writing to this object.

supersededBy.description: ch05: items need supersession. The itemId that replaced this one.

expiresAt.description: ch05: items need TTL. Null = no expiry; the projection marks status=expired when passed.

assertedBy.description: Provenance of the underlying assertion (ch05: Longshoremen write to the blackboard; Voyagers read scoped slices). This records WHO the projection derived the item from — it is not a write-permission field.

citations.description: ch05: items need source links. Every card traces to ledger facts — transcript events, files, or claims.

projection.description: Freshness envelope (C-routes convention): the blackboard is a projection; stale cards are labeled, never hidden, and never authorize anything.
